keyFindings.description: 4f15d975: a read can install a stale copy as the room's rendered replica. holdLive copies the room, a commit T lands, the observer fails to apply and recover() Resets the log (consuming T) and sets doc nil; startFromRead then sees doc nil and Pending 0 and installs the copy without T; the next base (with T) is skipped by observe because doc != nil (:480). The replica lacks T until the room unloads, and hold() serves it to reads and captureLiveTextAndAuthors. Fix: read the replica epoch before snapshotDocument and refuse in startFromRead when it changed; add a failing-first test.

f09fd0f9: a removal is raised to aw.Meta's clock (:695-700), and Meta also answers a live client. A client removed off its own goroutine (another tab that echoed it disconnects, or expiry) that re-announces at c+1 before touched reads Meta gets a removal at c+1, which other processes accept: they drop a live cursor and the client leaves local. Raise only when the room holds the client as a tombstone; drop the removal when it is live again; add a failing-first test.
